newsitem.title: USA: Universal Electronics names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Universal Electronics names new chairman.

text.p: Universal Electronics Inc said on Tuesday its President and Chief Executive David Gabrielsen was elected chairman of the board, replacing Frank Doherty.

Universal Electronics said it has entered into a preliminary agreement with its former officers Frank Doherty, Frank O'Donnell and Paul Darbee to pursue a venture to develop two-way interactive remote controls. Under the agreement, Universal Electronics would hold a minority stake in the new firm and would supply finished remote controls and related technology to them on a contract basis.

Doherty, O'Donnell and Darbee resigned from the board and from their officer positions with the company effective August 22. A search has begun to fill the management positions these changes have created.
Doherty had been chairman, O'Donnell had been senior vice president of technology sales and Darbee had been chief scientist and technical consultant.
Gabrielsen was not immediately available for comment.
